content.value_statement: Influencer budgets are hard to justify when rates, tiers, and channels vary. This skill builds allocation scenarios, ROI estimates, and reallocation moves from provided campaign inputs.
actual_capabilities: Builds influencer budget allocations by tier, platform, content type, and contingency.
Applies benchmark rate ranges for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and industry multipliers.
Projects reach, impressions, engagement, CPM, CPE, EMV, ROI, and ROAS when inputs allow.
Compares conservative, recommended, and aggressive budget scenarios with rationale.
Recommends mid-campaign reallocations when spend-to-date and creator results are provided.
Labels metrics as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated to separate evidence quality.
limitations: It does not discover creators or verify creator rates without external data from the user.
It does not replace legal, finance, or procurement approval for influencer contracts.
Benchmark-based projections are estimates and can differ from actual campaign results.
It does not execute live pacing changes or manage paid ad bids.

use_cases.title: Plan a Launch Budget
use_cases.description: Split a fixed launch budget across creator tiers, platforms, content formats, amplification, and contingency.

use_cases.title: Compare Funding Scenarios
use_cases.description: Model conservative, recommended, and aggressive spend levels before requesting approval from leadership.

use_cases.title: Reallocate Active Spend
use_cases.description: Move budget from underperforming creators to stronger performers using spend, reach, engagement, and ROI data.

prompt_templates.title: Starter Budget Allocation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a known budget and platforms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to allocate a $30,000 influencer budget across Instagram and TikTok for an awareness campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Tier Mix Recommendation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to recommend a nano, micro, and macro creator mix for a $75,000 beauty launch with at least 20 creators.

prompt_templates.title: Scenario Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare $50,000, $100,000, and $150,000 influencer budget scenarios for a Gen Z product launch.

prompt_templates.title: Mid-Campaign Reallocation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced optimization after early campaign results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to reallocate remaining budget using spend-to-date, creator results, CPM, CPE, and conversion data.

output_examples.input: A $30,000 skincare launch budget for Instagram and TikTok targeting Gen Z.
output_examples.output: A recommended split across TikTok creators, Instagram creators, content amplification, and contingency with projected reach and CPM.

output_examples.input: Three possible budgets for a product launch: $50,000, $100,000, and $150,000.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side scenario comparison showing creator count, tier mix, estimated reach, projected engagement, CPM, and recommended choice.

output_examples.input: Spend-to-date and creator performance from the first half of a campaign.
output_examples.output: A reallocation plan that reduces spend on weak performers and shifts budget toward creators with stronger ROI.

best_practices: Provide total budget, campaign goal, target audience, platforms, timeline, and any creator count constraints.
Separate fixed costs from creator spend so the allocation can sum correctly.
Replace benchmark estimates with measured creator rates and performance data whenever possible.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final plan without giving a total budget or clear scenario range.
Do not treat benchmark projections as guaranteed reach, revenue, or ROI.
Do not put most spend into one creator unless the concentration risk is intentional.

faq.question: Can this skill work without live influencer data?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use built-in benchmark ranges, but measured creator data improves accuracy.

faq.question: Does it choose specific creators?
faq.answer: No. It recommends budget ranges and tier mixes. Use a discovery skill to source creators.

faq.question: Can it support paid ads planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map spend to channels and campaigns for planning, but it does not manage live pacing.

faq.question: What inputs improve the ROI projection?
faq.answer: Past CPM, engagement rate, conversion rate, average order value, and creator rate data improve the projection.

faq.question: Can it handle mid-campaign changes?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide spend-to-date and performance by creator to get reallocation recommendations.

faq.question: Is the output ready for finance approval?
faq.answer: It can support a budget request, but finance and contract teams should review final commitments.
